title: The Backyard Treasure Hunt
moral: Exploring with friends makes every adventure special.

scenes.summary: Jack and Tom start a treasure hunt in the backyard.
scenes.text: Jack and Tom made a treasure map and started exploring their backyard.
scenes.image_prompt: two kids with map in backyard near tree, colorful cartoon

scenes.summary: They face obstacles like crossing a river.
scenes.text: They imagined a garden hose as a river and needed to cross it.
scenes.image_prompt: kids crossing plank over hose river, playful cartoon

scenes.summary: They explore jungle and sandbox areas.
scenes.text: They pretended the garden was a jungle and searched the sandbox for treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: kids digging sandbox treasure, bright cartoon

scenes.text: They found a wooden box with a note inside it.
scenes.image_prompt: kids opening treasure box in sandbox, cheerful cartoon

scenes.summary: They feel happy and plan more adventures.
scenes.text: They felt happy and excited for more adventures together.
scenes.image_prompt: kids smiling and planning next adventure, warm cartoon

story: Jack and Tom made a treasure map and explored their backyard. They crossed a pretend river and searched through a jungle and sandbox. They found a treasure box with a note inside. They were happy and excited to go on more adventures together.
